dct_description_sm: **ADAM ID: **[sm\_us6000qulb](https://api.adam.geospatial.wfp.org/api/collections/adam.adam_eq_events/items?uid=sm_us6000qulb) Magnitude 5.5 earthquake at 42.586 depth occurred on Jul 24 2025 47km E of Onondoa. The epicentre of the earthquake was located at latitude -2.0783 longitude 120.7193. It impacted 122274 people within 50km. WFP’s Automated Disaster Analysis and Mapping (ADAM) system is an operational system for collecting, analysing and mapping geospatial and socio-economic information following sudden onset humanitarian emergencies.
